# IPv6 iptables rules for testing
*filter
:INPUT DROP [0:0]
:FORWARD DROP [0:0]
:OUTPUT ACCEPT [0:0]
:STOP-BOTS - [0:0]

# Allow established connections
-I INPUT -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
-I INPUT -i lo -j ACCEPT

# Jump to STOP-BOTS chain
-I INPUT -j STOP-BOTS

# IPv6 bot blocking rules
-A STOP-BOTS -s 2001:db8::1 -j DROP
-A STOP-BOTS -s 2001:db8:85a3::8a2e:370:7334/64 -j DROP
-A STOP-BOTS -s 2606:4700:4700::1111 -j DROP

COMMIT
